scope: Browser prototype hammer, bubble lab, liquid pigments and version-1 migration; no Unity/device/network qualification

results.name: hammer cracks the struck ice locally, breaks on later taps, and never creates heat
simple hammer flow fully rescues a draggable dinosaur and keeps particle effects bounded
water melting and hammer chipping share the same retained ice
bubble film requires real water, soap and mixing before dipping
big bubbles spend more film, square wands still release round bubbles, pop is local
exhausted mixture cannot be refilled by repeated stirring; a fresh batch preserves flying bubbles
liquid pairs produce orange, green and purple independently of pour order
ratios change shade, water dilutes, equal three colors become earthy instead of white
liquid fill is bounded, settles without further taps, and resets only the chosen player
version-1 migration preserves all 56 earlier workspaces and adds four separate color labs
damaged/future saves are rejected and new records validate bounded shapes
four players can hammer, mix bubbles and mix colors without cross-player command mutation
